sections.description: SWP Psychology is a modern, lightweight, and fully customizable WordPress block theme designed for psychologists, therapists, counselors, psychotherapists, psychiatrists, life coaches, mental health clinics, wellness centers, and healthcare professionals. It is equally suited to medical and health websites such as doctors, clinics, hospitals, dentists, nutritionists, dietitians, physiotherapy and rehabilitation centers, as well as mindfulness, meditation, yoga, spa, fitness, nonprofit and charity, consulting, coaching, agency, corporate, small business, personal blog, magazine, news, and portfolio sites. Built for Gutenberg and the WordPress Full Site Editor, it lets you create and customize every part of your website using blocks—header, footer, colors, typography, and layout—without writing a single line of code. The theme includes professionally designed templates and block patterns for showcasing therapy and counseling services, team members, client testimonials and reviews, appointment and booking information, FAQs, pricing, blog posts, archives, search results, 404 pages, and contact pages. Its clean, calming, minimal design builds trust and delivers an excellent browsing experience across desktops, laptops, tablets, and mobile devices. SWP Psychology is a fast, SEO friendly, mobile responsive, and accessibility minded theme that loads quickly and helps you reach more potential clients. It supports Global Styles, block patterns, custom block styles, editor styles, wide and full width blocks, custom logo, custom menus, custom colors and backgrounds, featured images, sticky posts, threaded comments, footer widgets, RTL languages, and is fully translation ready and compatible with the latest WordPress features. Whether you are building a private practice website, counseling center, psychology clinic, therapy blog, or wellness business, SWP Psychology gives you everything you need to launch a professional online presence with ease.
